sentences.bandCaption: Min / nominal / max is an envelope of named one-at-a-time scenarios. Interactions are not evaluated. It is not a confidence interval, an error bar, or a physical lower or upper bound.
sentences.belowOnset: This cavity hypothesis gives zero depression at P/P*<=1. Melting is determined separately by the finite-Gaussian liquidus test; it is not guaranteed.
sentences.beltonHelp: This mode replaces the alloy's direct slope with a clean-Fe single-solute analogue. At zero solute it already changes the baseline; compare solute effects with zero solute in the same Fe mode, not with the alloy direct preset.
sentences.fieldShape: At or below onset the link uses the finite Gaussian field; above onset it uses a surface point plus line. The two fields differ, so the linked depth can change at P* because of field shape, not because of a cavity (P8 spec Amendment 3 C2).
sentences.inRange: This diagnostic is inside its declared input range; no sourced onset reference or blind validation is available.
sentences.ledgers: The chosen spatial split is photon-conservative without reconciling the cavity-wall thermal ledger.
sentences.lowAspect: Above onset the selected cavity has e/d below 0.5, outside the thermal-cylinder source geometry. This is an extrapolated conditional estimate, and cavity mechanics are omitted.
sentences.lowPe: Pe is below 2: the high-Pe thermal-cylinder closure is transferred outside its source range, and drilling, recoil-driven flow and melt transport are omitted. A converged series removes neither limitation.
sentences.marangoni: This surface-flow diagnostic uses a transferred or user-supplied coefficient; the velocity is a scale and no melt-depth correction is available.
sentences.marangoniHelp: Try a surface-tension slope or a single-solute chemistry analogue. Ma and velocity are diagnostic scales; they do not correct the melt depth.
sentences.module.alSi10MgIndexDisclosure: The regime index keeps its historical absorption convention; physical absorption is different.
sentences.module.alSi10MgVapourMgAware: Ideal-mixture vapour sensitivity; extrapolated Mg pressure, no blind validation.
sentences.module.keyholeCavity: Conditional cavity estimate on the served conduction-kernel properties; the served keyhole leg uses room-temperature solid properties, so the two can differ (see Differences); no blind validation.
sentences.module.marangoni: Surface-flow diagnostic from preset or user coefficients with an assumed temperature difference and length; the velocity is a scale, not a solved flow field; no blind validation.
sentences.module.meltDepthLink: Conditional melt-depth construction: the finite Gaussian conduction floor at or below onset, a surface point plus line source above it; the two fields differ near onset; no blind validation.
sentences.module.surfaceBalance: Beam-centre diagnostic of a falsified flat surface-balance closure; the numbers are closure artefacts, not a surface temperature; no blind validation.
sentences.module.unavailablePhysics: These closures need missing inputs or new physics and are not available.
sentences.nearOnset: Near onset the linked depth is dominated by the change of field shape; controlling-leg support does not show that a cavity caused the increase.
sentences.o8: This Mg-inclusive feedstock-composition scenario changes conditional onset, cavity and melt depth as well as surface temperature, evaporation and recoil; Mg pressure is extrapolated and none is a validated alloy prediction.
sentences.onsetMismatch: The loss-free dwell onset and the flat surface balance can disagree. They are separate uncoupled hypotheses; neither reconciles the other's losses.
sentences.onsetSupport: Equal-weight named inception scenarios, not a calibrated probability. Excluded: O2 (geometric-R-about-1) is a geometric threshold and is listed separately.
